about: Known problems in released versions, matched by rules in /fixme (core/fixme.py). It ships inside each signed release. Fields: id; versions ("<0.5.11", ">=0.5.14,<0.5.16", "0.5.14" or "*"); seen (what you see); checks (doctor or health check ids it explains); symptom (a regular expression for a failing check's line or your words); keywords (phrases: all their words in what you typed); fix (what to do); action (optional: "update", or "fix:<check id>" for that check's Fix). How to add one: docs/wiki/dev/debugging.md.

issues.seen: The dashboard's NOTES map is empty, but its top line counts notes
issues.fix: A note with hundreds of links threw the map off the screen. Update to 0.5.11 or later, then reload the dashboard.

issues.seen: The Android app closes as soon as you open it
issues.fix: A bug in the 0.7.0 phone app on Android 8 and up (the mark at the top of Today couldn't be drawn). Update to 0.7.1: the app then offers the new version, or install it from the pairing page.
